visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian male with black hair wearing a black t-shirt with a yellow stripe on the shoulder stands in a modern living room. He looks directly at the camera, talking and using expressive hand gestures like pointing up and opening his palms wide. Behind him, a grey leather sofa and warm indoor lighting are visible. A brief cut shows a dark, illustrative image of the monster Cthulhu rising from green waves with tentacles and large wings. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen environment with a stainless steel range hood and white tile walls. The male creator holds a bottle of blue Monin syrup and pours the vibrant blue liquid into a small white pot with colorful numbers on it sitting on a gas stove. He then adds white lotus seeds and a tube of green wasabi paste, stirring the mixture which turns a deep, murky turquoise. He also holds up a whole raw octopus, showing its suckers to the lens before chopping it on a wooden board. (3) The creator is back in the living room setting, holding a white bowl filled with the cooked blue soup containing whole octopus tentacles and lotus seeds. He uses a gold spoon to lift the thick, viscous liquid and octopus pieces, placing them in his mouth. He makes intense facial expressions ranging from forced smiles to visible disgust and confusion. Blue stains are seen on his lips as he talks to the camera about the strange texture of the food. (4) The video transitions to high-quality CGI game trailer footage from 'Once Human.' It shows various characters in tactical gear running through a forest under a massive, glowing eye in the sky. Grotesque monsters with multiple limbs and glowing parts appear in dark corridors and snowy landscapes. The color palette is dark, cinematic, and saturated with purples and reds. The game logo 'Once Human' appears with text detailing an update date.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks Chinese with high arousal and a bright, animated tone. The speech rate is fast and energetic. In the background, a light-hearted, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM plays with a steady 4/4 beat. The vocal delivery is clear and professionally projected for social media engagement. (2) The audio features a dense layering of foley sounds including the distinct gurgling and splashing of liquid being poured into a pot. The male voice continues with enthusiastic interjections and loud 'Yeah' shouts. Rapid-fire metallic chopping sounds on a wooden surface create a rhythmic percussive texture. The BGM remains consistent but lower in the mix compared to the loud, sharp sound effects of cooking. (3) Slurping and chewing sounds dominate as the speaker tastes the food, followed by guttural sounds of mild disgust and strained talking. The BGM tempo feels faster as the speaker’s vocal intensity fluctuates between comedic commentary and reaction sounds. There is a noticeable squelching sound effect added for emphasis on the soup's viscosity. (4) A dramatic acoustic shift occurs with a deep orchestral riser and a heavy bass drop. The previous pop BGM is replaced by epic, cinematic music with high harmonic tension. A deep, authoritative male narrator speaks slowly in Chinese. Loud SFX of explosions, monster roars, and digital glitches are interspersed, creating a high-arousal and tense atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous and slightly shocking food challenge (making and eating Cthulhu-themed blue octopus soup) to grab attention and build a thematic bridge to an advertisement for the supernatural game 'Once Human.'
